entities.summary: Mo Abbaro, also known professionally as Mo Abdalla or Mohammed Ahmed Abdalla Abbaro, was a London-based Sudanese ceramicist and potter, who has been described by artist Oliver Bloom as "one of the world's finest ceramicists".
